scope: one schema-v7 winner; exact artifact, benchmark executable, cache group, attention profile, selected chunk, executed dispatch inventory, dispatch resources joined to embedded IU4/IU8/BF16 ISA, the existing Q4 wave32 path used by MTP regression, and conditional selected-workload loaded-ELF FP8 paths
required_inputs: one selected-route dispatch reconciliation whose inventory binds the schema-v7 artifact/executable/profile

the selected trace's executed Q4 wave32 path and its embedded static IU4/resource proof; existing whole graph/eager/token/acceptance evidence owns MTP behavior, with no separate MTP optimization proof

for a four-role hybrid winner only, a selected trace with load-time code-object capture plus gate/up and attention loaded-ELF FP8 proofs; every relevant dispatch maps through its database code-object URI to captured ELF bytes whose exact SHA and SGPR/architectural-VGPR/accumulator-VGPR/LDS/private-segment fields match the qualified native-FP8 ISA/resource proof; unavailable spill counters remain explicitly unavailable

conditional_route_gates.all_q4: executed Q4 CTA, selected dense full-score or XAttention rank/consumer, and executed Q4 wave32 path used by retained MTP regression
conditional_route_gates.mixed: all-Q4 requirements plus executed W8 CTA/IU8; no MTP-bulk optimization proof is an admission gate
conditional_route_gates.four_role_hybrid: all-Q4 requirements plus both native-FP8 algorithms joined from every relevant selected dispatch through database code-object URI/load identity to captured ELF bytes, the exact qualified ELF SHA, and its retained SGPR/architectural-VGPR/accumulator-VGPR/LDS/private-segment envelope with separately represented spill availability; all selected dispatch resource fields must agree and kernel-name equality alone fails
conditional_route_gates.xattention: both rank and selected G16/G32 consumer must occur in the actual inventory; binary presence alone fails

excluded_claims: cross-operation overlap beyond the exact Q4 CTA static checker
known_preparation_blockers: Static schedule/reconciliation supports dense or fixed tau=0.9 XAttention and Q4/W8/four-role FP8 classification at C1 P2048. The prepared physical trace command resolves the future winner and its exact pareto-whole artifact/executable/profile/chunk identities; executing and validating that trace waits for terminal selection. A dense counterpart is not substituted for sparse or hybrid execution.

MTP shortlist-head, alternate-precision, and mixed MTP-bulk optimization evidence are not scheduled and cannot gate this verifier; existing MTP behavior remains covered by whole graph/eager/token/acceptance evidence plus the selected trace/static paths.
publication: Reject the final namespace under lstat semantics, recompute the complete selected route/reconciliation/conditional proof result immediately before publication, publish one same-directory hard link without overwrite, reopen and recompute after publication, fsync the directory, and remove only the newly published inode if final revalidation fails.
